verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a first-party local API, an official MCP server that converts its OpenAPI spec into MCP tools for natural-language AI interaction, and an 'Anytype Agents' skill explicitly designed to plug into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and other agent-capable tools, plus a CLI for headless automation — directly matching the story's ask for first-party connectors and an AI-tool ecosystem. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that these MCP/agent integrations work reliably in practice, and broader evidence of a third-party AI plugin ecosystem beyond the documented official tools.
